title: Inventory: Boocock et al. 2025 (eLife 13:RP95566) supplementary files
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/boocock2025/raw/`: the version-of-record supplementary files fetched from
`https://cdn.elifesciences.org/articles/95566/` with plain requests (2026-11-02). The eLife article page refused plain requests (HTTP 406),
so the article text is the PMC full text (PMC11903034) fetched through NCBI E-utilities (`efetch db=pmc`) and kept as `sources/boocock2025/article_pmc.xml`.
Zip files are kept untouched; their inner tarballs are listed in `extracted/supp4_members.tsv` and `extracted/supp8_members.tsv`. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.elife-95566-supp1-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 1: yeast strains (Table S1), plasmids (S2), primers (S3), single-cell dataset summary per cross incl. parents and effect directions (S4), variance decomposition by cell-cycle stage (S5), local eQTL for the 393 previously genotyped segregants (S6).
roles.elife-95566-supp2-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 2: local eQTL summary statistics for the one-pot experiments, one sheet per cross (A = BY × RM, B = YJM145 × YPS163, C = CBS2888 × YJM981); every tested transcript with FDR.
roles.elife-95566-supp3-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 3: distant eQTL summary statistics (FDR < 5%) per cross, with hotspot bin.
roles.elife-95566-supp4-v1.zip: Supplementary file 4: hotspot annotation (fine-mapping) workbooks per cross, as FileS4_VOR.tar.gz; member list in extracted/supp4_members.tsv.
roles.elife-95566-supp5-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 5: single-cell allele-specific expression (ASE) in the parental hybrids, per cross.
roles.elife-95566-supp6-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 6: allele-specific effects on expression noise and mean, per cross.
roles.elife-95566-supp7-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 7: cell-cycle occupancy QTL summary statistics, per cross.
roles.elife-95566-supp8-v1.zip: Supplementary file 8: alignment and tree files from a clustered BLAST search of Gpa1 (YHR005C), as FileS8_VOR.tar.gz; member list in extracted/supp8_members.tsv.
roles.elife-95566-supp9-v1.xlsx: Supplementary file 9: single-cell RNA-seq of GPA1 82R/82W allele-replacement strains contrasted with distant eQTL near GPA1.

missing: No eQTL confidence intervals: Supplementary files 2 and 3 give the closest or peak marker only (the paper computed 1.5-LOD intervals but did not tabulate them).
No tabulated hotspot peak or CI: the paper's hotspot CI (10th/90th percentiles of the top-20 eQTL CIs) is not in the supplement; hotspot ranges come from the fine-mapping workbook names.
No segregant counts per cross (each cell is a segregant; cell counts are in Table S4).

Raw count matrices and genotypes are on Dryad (doi:10.5061/dryad.xgxd254qb) and Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.12695127), not fetched; code at github.com/joshsbloom/single_cell_eQTL and github.com/theboocock/*.
